recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future work group wants FHIR-core profile pages to add or rename a first tab to Key Elements, handle that as a new renderer/template request rather than as missing application of FHIR-40471.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking that profile presentations in Implementation Guides and the core specification default to Key Elements instead of the Differential table so modifier and other implementation-significant elements are less likely to be missed.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit tagged FHIR-40471 was found. The Jira comment and 2024 IG Authoring minutes show the request was applied through HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#879, which was later closed completed.
additional_context: Zulip discussion confirmed the rationale and recorded that Key Elements defects needed to be fixed before making it the default. A July 2025 IG creation thread says the current base template should already default to Key Elements. Current core profile output uses template-profile.html with Text Summary first and Differential View second, so core does not default to the differential view that motivated the issue.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. This audit commit records that the core checkout does not need a FHIR-40471 source correction and that the IG-specific implementation path was completed in external IG Publisher/base-template tooling.
